tour.title: How this site works
tour.intro: A two-minute tour of the editor: where things live, how to change them, and how to make a change go live.

steps.title: Welcome to your site's editor
steps.body:
Every word, price, picture and menu on the public site is edited here, with no code and no developer.

This tour takes about two minutes. You can leave it any time with Skip tour, and bring it back later from the Help page in the sidebar.

steps.title: Save keeps a draft. Publish makes it live.
steps.body:
This is the one rule that catches everyone. Saving keeps your change private. Nothing changes on the public site until you press Publish.

After you publish, the change shows on the live site within a few seconds. If a page still looks old after a minute, reload it with Ctrl+Shift+R.

steps.title: Site settings: the details used everywhere
steps.body: Your email, phone, location, social links, tagline and the footer's seasonal line live in Site settings. Change one box here and it updates the header, footer, contact page and search results together.

steps.title: Pages: the words on each page
steps.body:
The Pages group holds one entry per page of the site: Home, Services, About, Contact, Work, Photography, Journal and the not-found page. Open the one you want, change the words, then publish.

The small limit under some boxes is on purpose. It protects a layout that would break one character later.

steps.title: Pricing and services
steps.body:
The three price tiers, the add-on cards and the Services chapters each have their own entries. Change a price in one place and it updates on the homepage and the Services page.

When a price really changes, three sentences elsewhere may quote the old number. The editing guide has a short checklist for them.

steps.title: Case Studies: the portfolio
steps.body: One entry per client project. Tick Featured on the homepage to show a study on the front page (the three newest featured ones appear). Never write a testimonial a client has not actually said; leave those boxes empty.

steps.title: Journal: write and publish entries
steps.body: Write an entry, then publish it. One rule matters here: the Summary box is required. An entry with an empty Summary is hidden from the whole site, even when it is published, so fill it in every time.

steps.title: Photography: add photos
steps.body: Each photo is an entry with a picture, a group (Events, Portraits or Environments), a year and a short description of what it shows. A photo without that description is left off the page on purpose, so people using screen readers are not shut out.

steps.title: What to leave alone
steps.body:
Content Types: never edit anything there. Deleting or retyping a field deletes the words stored in it, and History cannot bring them back.

Comments, Widgets, Sections and Bylines are part of the editor but the site does not use them, so ignore them. Settings, General is ignored too: the site reads Site settings instead. And never delete or unpublish an entry under Site settings or Pages, because those hold the words the site is built from.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.body:
The Help page in the sidebar lists everything in this tour, a table of I want to change this, so I go there, and the leave-alone list. Every entry editor also has an About this screen note in its sidebar saying what that screen controls.

The full step-by-step editing guide is docs/EDITING-GUIDE.md in the site's GitHub repository (NateJ45/nixoncreativestudio). If something looks broken and the undo steps in its section 6 do not fix it, email the studio at the address in the site footer.

leaveAlone.title: Content Types
leaveAlone.body: Never edit anything here. Deleting a field or changing its type deletes the words stored in it, and History does not bring them back. The fields and their limits are defined in the site's code.

leaveAlone.title: Comments, Widgets, Sections, Bylines
leaveAlone.body: These screens come with the editor and cannot be hidden, but the site does not use them. They are empty. Ignore them.

leaveAlone.title: Settings, General
leaveAlone.body: The public site reads Site settings instead, so editing the title or tagline here changes nothing people see.

leaveAlone.title: Entries under Site settings and Pages
leaveAlone.body: Edit them as much as you like, but never delete or unpublish one. If one goes missing the site falls back to a built-in copy of older words, and your edits stop showing until you publish the entry again.

leaveAlone.title: Users, Plugins, Import
leaveAlone.body: Admin tools with nothing to do day to day.

topics.title: How a change goes live
topics.body:
Save keeps a draft that nobody else can see. Publish (or Publish changes on an entry that is already live) makes it live. The live site refreshes within a few seconds. If a page still looks old after a minute, reload with Ctrl+Shift+R.

Made a mistake? Open the entry, use History to see earlier versions, restore the last good one and publish it.

topics.title: Where the full guide lives
topics.body: The step-by-step editing guide, with three practice edits that each end with an undo, is docs/EDITING-GUIDE.md in the site's GitHub repository, NateJ45/nixoncreativestudio.

topics.title: Who to call
topics.body: If something looks broken, start with section 6 of the editing guide (History, the Cloudflare rollback, the database restore). If you are still stuck, email the studio at the address in the site footer.

site_settings.controls: Your contact details, social links, tagline, footer line and the default closing banner, used across the whole site.
site_settings.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry.
site_settings.live: Every page that shows these details refreshes within a few seconds.

page_home.controls: The words on the homepage: the headline, section headings and the four process steps.
page_home.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry. The headline is two boxes, the plain part and the coloured part.

page_services.controls: The words on the Services page, including the questions and answers (3 to 10 rows).
page_services.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry. If you change a price, check the answer to What does it cost?

page_about.controls: The About text, headshot and the Currently block.
page_about.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry. The Lighthouse numbers are measured facts; change them only after a real re-measure.

page_contact.controls: The words on the Contact page and the choices in the form.
page_contact.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry. Renaming a choice changes what arrives in your inquiry email.

page_work.controls: The headline and intro on the Work page.
page_work.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry.

page_photography.controls: The headline and the text above the Events, Portraits and Environments groups.
page_photography.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry.

page_journal.controls: The headline, intro and empty-state words on the Journal page.
page_journal.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry.

page_not_found.controls: The words on the page people see when an address does not exist.
page_not_found.leaveAlone: Never delete or unpublish this entry.

pages.controls: The Privacy, Accessibility and Colophon pages.
pages.leaveAlone: Never delete an entry. Set Last updated to today when the text changes, and keep the facts true: what the site collects, which tools it uses, how it is hosted.

pricing_tiers.controls: One of the three price tiers shown on the homepage and the Services page.
pricing_tiers.live: Both the homepage band and the Services page update within a few seconds. Then check the three sentences that quote prices (see the editing guide).

pricing_addons.controls: One add-on card in the Add to any project section of Services.

service_offerings.controls: One chapter of the Services page (Strategy, Web design or Photography).

case_studies.controls: One portfolio project, shown on the Work page and at its own address.
case_studies.leaveAlone: Never write a testimonial a client has not said. Leave the quote boxes empty instead.
case_studies.live: The page appears on Work and at its own address. The share image for social media is built at the next site update, so it may take a while.

posts.leaveAlone: Save keeps a draft nobody can see. The Summary box is required: an entry with an empty Summary is hidden from the whole site even when published.
posts.live: The entry appears on the Journal page. The Journal link joins the menus on its own once one entry is live.

photos.controls: One photo on the Photography page.
photos.leaveAlone: A photo without a description of what it shows is left off the page on purpose.
photos.live: The gallery fills in on its own.

collectionDefault.controls: A set of entries on the public site.
collectionDefault.live: Save keeps a draft. Publish makes the change live within a few seconds.
